subject: fix: compare metadata minimum version during reconciliation (#1447)
reason: The change swaps top_level_version for top_level_min_version in the single reconciliation gate in MetadataManager::ReconcileMetadata. A differing accept/reject decision requires proposed metadata whose logical counter (top_level_version) and minimum-version (top_level_min_version) straddle the module-version integer (1.3.0 = 66304) in opposite directions. This is unreachable in a fuzzer run: both module builds are the same version (1.3.0), so ComputeMinVersion never yields a min_version above 66304 and the min-version direction shows no divergence; the counter direction needs >66304 FT.CREATE/
